latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Grant Proposal Assistant for NIH and NSF grants.

- Provides templates and section generators for NIH (R01/R21), NSF, and other major grant proposals.
- Includes tools for writing Specific Aims, research strategy, budget justifications, and other sections.
- Offers best practice guidance, review checklists, and proposal critique features.
- Supports command-line usage and Python integration.
- No external dependencies or network access required.
